text: Hey, let me know if you have any questions. Okay, first make sure you use the right amount of water, you don’ want it swimming, you just want it covered, that helps a lot. Also keep the heat medium, not too hot or you' end up with a sticky mess, and make sure you stir it while it cooks, that usually stops it from getting gummy. Yeah, a quick garnish could be a drizzle of good olive oil, a sprinkle of sea salt, a few chopped fresh herbs like cilantro or parsley, some sliced green onions, even a tiny bit of lemon juice. Those add color and flavor without much work.
